steps.text: Go inspect Sir Amik Varze in Lumbridge Castle.
Inspect Sir Amik Varze.
Talk to the Lumbridge Cook.
Talk to the Lumbridge Cook and ask him all the options about Sir Amik Varze.
Talk to the Wise Old Man in Draynor Village about strange beasts and the Evil Chicken.
choices: I'd just like to ask you something.

steps.text: Use a bucket of milk on a pot of cream.
Use cornflour on the milky mixture.
Add a vanilla pod to the cornflour mixture.
Travel to Zanaris.
Use a raw chicken on the Chicken Shrine in the north east of Zanaris.
Kill the Evil Chicken in the north of the range. Pray protect from magic against it.
Pick up the evil chicken egg.
Use the evil chickens egg on the brulee.
Kill a black dragon.
Pick up the dragon token.
Use a pestle and mortar on the dramen branch.
Use the cinnamon on the brulee.
Equip your Ice Gloves and rub the dragon token in Lumbridge or Zanaris. Ask the fairy dragon to cook your brulee.
choices: Please flambe this creme brulee for me.

steps.text: Go give the Brulee to Sir Amik Varze to finish the quest.
Give the Brulee to Sir Amik Varze to finish the quest.
